fullContentHtml:
Union Bank of India Apprentices Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Bank of India (UBI) has released the Result for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment was released for 1865 posts. Applications for the Union Bank of India Apprentices Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 29 April 2026, to19 May 2026. The written examination was conducted on 07 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their Union Bank of India Apprentices Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 April 2026
  • Last Date : 19 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 June 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result : 24 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 944/-
  • General, OBC Female : Rs. 708/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Transgender : Rs. 236/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification

What is Union Bank of India Apprentices Result 2026?

Union Bank of India Apprentices Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 19 May 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.unionbankofindia.co.in/

How to download result?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
